# AnophelesEntoTrials

AnophelesEntoTrials estimates the entomological efficacy of malaria
vector control interventions from entomological trials. It fits Bayesian
models of the mosquito feeding cycle to the data with Stan, to estimate
intervention effects such as the reduction in host availability,
pre-prandial killing and post-prandial killing.

The package provides two predefined models:

| Model | `model_type` | Experimental design | Reference |
|----|----|----|----|
| Basic model | `"basic"` | Experimental hut trials (EHT) | Champagne et al. (2025) |
| Semifield model | `"semifield"` | Matched semifield experiments with a spatial repellent | Denz et al. (2021) |

Custom Stan models can also be fitted with the same workflow.

## Installation

``` r

install.packages("devtools")

# Install the package from GitHub
devtools::install_github("SwissTPH/AnophelesEntoTrials", build_vignettes = TRUE)
```

The models are compiled with rstan, which requires a C++ toolchain
(Rtools on Windows).

## Getting started

``` r

library(AnophelesEntoTrials)

# Simulated hut trial data (or import your own with import_ento_data())
eht_data <- format_eht_data(simulate_eht_data(seed = 42))

fit <- fit_ento_model(eht_data, model_type = "basic", seed = 123)
extract_stan_summary(fit, data = eht_data)
```

The vignettes describe the workflow in detail:

- [`vignette("format-data")`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/articles/format-data.md):
  importing and formatting entomological data
- [`vignette("workflow-predefined-models")`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/articles/workflow-predefined-models.md):
  the predefined models, their mathematical description, fitting,
  results and posterior predictive checks
- [`vignette("workflow-custom-models")`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/articles/workflow-custom-models.md):
  fitting your own Stan models

## References

- Champagne C, Lemant J, et al. (2025). Cascades of effectiveness of
  next-generation insecticide-treated nets against malaria, from
  entomological trials to real-life conditions. *Nature Communications*
  16:11162. <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-025-66130-y>
- Denz A, Njoroge MM, et al. (2021). Predicting the impact of outdoor
  vector control interventions on malaria transmission intensity from
  semi-field studies. *Parasites & Vectors* 14:64.
  <https://doi.org/10.1186/s13071-020-04560-x>

# Package index

## All functions

- [`check_file_integrity()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/check_file_integrity.md)
  : Check file integrity and required columns
- [`extract_posteriorMax()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/extract_posteriorMax.md)
  : Extract posteriorMax estimates
- [`extract_stan_posteriors()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/extract_stan_posteriors.md)
  : Extract posterior samples from Stan fit
- [`extract_stan_summary()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/extract_stan_summary.md)
  : Extract summary statistics from Stan fit
- [`fit_ento_model()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/fit_ento_model.md)
  : Fit Bayesian Ento-Trials model
- [`format_eht_data()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/format_eht_data.md)
  : Format EHT data to standard structure
- [`generate_inits_basic()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/generate_inits_basic.md)
  : Generate initial values for basic Stan model
- [`generate_inits_semifield()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/generate_inits_semifield.md)
  : Generate initial values for semifield model
- [`import_ento_data()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/import_ento_data.md)
  : Import entomological hut trial data
- [`list_available_models()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/list_available_models.md)
  : List available predefined Stan models
- [`plot_posterior_predictive()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/plot_posterior_predictive.md)
  : Plot a posterior predictive check
- [`posterior_predictive_check()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/posterior_predictive_check.md)
  : Posterior predictive check
- [`prepare_stan_data()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/prepare_stan_data.md)
  : Prepare data for Stan
- [`prepare_stan_data_semifield()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/prepare_stan_data_semifield.md)
  : Prepare data for semifield Stan model
- [`simulate_eht_data()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/simulate_eht_data.md)
  : Simulate entomological hut trial data from the basic model
- [`standardize_column_names()`](https://swisstph.github.io/AnophelesEntoTrials/reference/standardize_column_names.md)
  : Standardize column names to expected EHT format
